De 71-jarige Finkers was het vaakst voorgedragen en kreeg veruit de meeste stemmen. De in 2003 overleden dichter en liedjesschrijver Willem Wilmink werd tweede. De eveneens overleden Leendert Overduin eindigde op de derde plek. Hij leidde in de Tweede Wereldoorlog een organisatie voor hulp aan Joden. Finkers reageerde op de voor hem kenmerkende droge, relativerende manier op de titel. "De grootste Twentenaar áller tijden. Nou, daar denkt mijn vrouw heel anders over." title: Uyghurs facing deportation by Thailand say they will be ‘like slaves’ in China
summary: Activists fear Bangkok will give in to pressure from Beijing despite reports of torture and human rights abuses against the mostly muslim ethnic minority The deportation of two more Uyghurs to China from Thailand would put their lives in grave danger, activists have said, with one of the men saying he would be “like a slave” if he was sent back. Last year, Thai authorities forcibly deported 40 Uyghur men to China despite pleas from the men themselves and the UN. The US and Canada had reportedly offered to resettle them , but Bangkok appeared to want to avoid upsetting Beijing. The UN has said the returnees’ whereabouts remain unknown. Continue reading...
